scripts.dev:web: pnpm --parallel --stream --filter backend --filter admin --filter app run dev
scripts.setup:backend: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend prisma:migrate:deploy && pnpm --filter backend prisma:seed
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm run setup:env && pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run setup:backend
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @rtnn/config build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-schemas build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/api-sdk build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/native-bridge build
scripts.build:backend:deps: pnpm --filter @rtnn/config build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @rtnn/shared-schemas build
scripts.prepare:backend: pnpm run build:backend:deps && pnpm --filter backend prisma:generate
scripts.build:backend: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend build
scripts.contracts:permissions: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend generate:permissions
scripts.contracts:sync: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm --filter backend export:openapi && pnpm --filter @rtnn/api-sdk generate && pnpm --filter @rtnn/api-sdk build
scripts.check:static: pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:typecheck && pnpm run check:admin-ui && pnpm run check:template-neutrality && pnpm run check:contracts

scripts.check:native-bridge: pnpm --filter @rtnn/native-bridge build && node --test tests/native-bridge.test.mjs && node --test tests/app-native-core.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:typecheck && pnpm run check:admin-ui && pnpm run check:template-neutrality && pnpm run check:template-derivation && pnpm run check:contracts && pnpm run check:backend-release && pnpm run check:build
scripts.smoke:admin:ui: node scripts/runtime/run-playwright-ui-smoke.mjs --preflight; code=$?; if [ "$code" = "80" ]; then exit 0; elif [ "$code" != "0" ]; then exit "$code"; fi; pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm run build:admin && node scripts/runtime/run-playwright-ui-smoke.mjs -c tooling/playwright/admin.config.ts
scripts.smoke:app:ui: node scripts/runtime/run-playwright-ui-smoke.mjs --preflight; code=$?; if [ "$code" = "80" ]; then exit 0; elif [ "$code" != "0" ]; then exit "$code"; fi; pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm run build:app && node scripts/runtime/run-playwright-ui-smoke.mjs -c tooling/playwright/app.config.ts
scripts.smoke:weapp:h5: node scripts/runtime/run-playwright-ui-smoke.mjs --preflight; code=$?; if [ "$code" = "80" ]; then exit 0; elif [ "$code" != "0" ]; then exit "$code"; fi; pnpm run postgres:up && pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter weapp typecheck && node scripts/runtime/run-playwright-ui-smoke.mjs -c tooling/playwright/weapp.config.ts
